stock.description: Tonking New Energy Group Holdings Limited functions as an investment holding company, deeply involved in the renewable energy sector throughout the People's Republic of China. Its operational scope includes offering comprehensive, integrated services for solar power plants, selling its proprietary photovoltaic tracking mounting systems, engaging in research and development of solar power innovations, and generating and distributing electricity. The company, founded in 2004, was previously named JC Group Holdings Limited until its rebranding to Tonking New Energy Group Holdings Limited in May 2016. Its headquarters are located in Tsim Sha Tsui, Hong Kong.
